$comment: Native Dropdown trigger, from ui/lib/nidara-kit/styles/_components.scss dropdown > button and _base-layer.scss dropdown > button > box/arrow. Settings uses fse-small instead of fixed fs-small. RADIUS.sm is the same nidara-radius-sm. Final native values still need owner live review.
The arrow size 16 is the GTK default documented in _base-layer.scss, not a new native visual choice. Default applies to every component mode variant.

Menu list from _components.scss dropdown popover > contents/listview/.nidara-dropdown-item and scrolled.ts NidaraDropDown factory. Chosen check uses check.ts path with 2.2/24 stroke, requested at14, always reserving its slot. Hover/focus is accent; it never changes the chosen check.
